findings.text: blocking: the done_when's negative control is 'the same measure at the base revision records ticks over 30 seconds', and logs/tick-base-all_debug.log records a base maximum of 8.997 s with over_bound=0, so the measure never demonstrates the defect the node was dispatched to remove; the fragment discloses this but still marks the record plan-verdict passed at line 12, leaving a section claiming a verdict its own control does not support.

non-blocking: the instrument paragraph says each of the 20 ticks appends 32 KiB to every run's stream, while the two arms in the fragment's own table record arrival_bytes 8192 in logs/tick-base-all_debug.json and logs/tick-head-all_debug.json; 32 KiB is the 1mb arms' figure, so the paragraph describes the secondary arm and not the table it introduces.

non-blocking: the measure arms' logs open straight into the JSON result with no '# revision:' or '# command:' header line, so neither arm names the command that produced it and a later reader cannot re-run the arm from its own log the way the suite arms' logs allow.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against 0f519315992f42: 4d188b03e2 adds the 237-line measure harness, 325e19aa96 adds 27 lines to reckon/crew/recovery_wait.py splitting each memoised scan into a memo wrapper plus a renamed _read_last_tool_call/_scan_stream_assistant_record and adds the 119-line guard test, 11491f785b adds the two evidence fragments; no other file changes and no behaviour outside the two scans is touched.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when is a 20-tick, 230-run measure on all_debug recording duration and resident memory per tick with a base-revision negative control recording ticks over 30 seconds; logs/tick-base-all_debug.log and logs/tick-head-all_debug.log each carry 20 readings with over_bound=0 and EXIT=0, and the control did not fire (base max 8.997 s, 1mb arm 18.319 s), so the gate asserts the first clause and not the second.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is to keep the station tick under 30 seconds and under 2 GB at 230 live runs (the reviewed run's prompt.txt:38); the landed change memoises the two per-run stream scans at reckon/crew/recovery_wait.py:125 and :1459, which takes a quiet tick from 874 stream opens to 0, but the base arm already read 8.997 s against the 30 s bound so the goal line itself was not crossed by the node.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete, three commits 4d188b03e2/325e19aa96/11491f785b, changed_paths the five landed files, both suite arms at EXIT=0 (58 passed base, 61 passed head), negative_control_log at 2 failed/EXIT=1, four measure logs, and evidence_inputs stating the negative control does not reproduce at 230 live runs with its figures.

(prompt.txt:84-89); git diff --stat 0f519315992f42..11491f785b39 lists exactly five files and every one of them falls inside that fence.

justifications.durability: tests/test_a_quiet_tick_at_fleet_scale_reads_no_stream.py:63 asserts opened == [] after a second quiet tick and :100 asserts set(opened) == {str(streams[0])}, both against the fixture's own stream paths; the recorded mutation that removes the memo reddens both at logs/negative-control.log (2 failed, EXIT=1).
justifications.evidence: logs/tick-base-all_debug.log and logs/tick-head-all_debug.log each carry 20 tick durations and RSS readings with 0 over the 30 s and 2 GiB bound, but the done_when's second clause is the base revision recording ticks over 30 s and logs/tick-base-all_debug.log shows the control at 8.997 s, which the fragment at docs/evidence/fragments/work-scales-to-eighty-across-nodes/s5.html:36 discloses.
justifications.fit: the two added helpers read as the module's other scan helpers in reckon/crew/recovery_wait.py and reuse an existing repo module rather than introducing a naming style; the added text carries no plan, sprint or ticket identifier and the test file follows the repo's test_a_<behaviour> convention.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/recovery_wait.py:125 and :1459 memoise the two per-run stream scans, which drops a quiet tick's stream opens from 874 to 0, but the base arm in logs/tick-base-all_debug.log records 0 readings over bound at 8.997 s so the landed change lowers cost rather than crossing the 30 s line the goal names.
justifications.reuse: the added memo calls reckon/file_memo.py:362 memoized, the owner of per-file parses keyed on stat identity, with the same use at reckon/crew/review.py:547; the search over reckon/crew for memoised or hand-rolled caches found only per-run caches of git answers (reckon/crew/recovery_watch.py:86), a different capability, so nothing is duplicated.
